name: wordmark, tagline and cta hold
looks: The small app icon and brand name settle centred with a short tagline fading up beneath them. A solid call-to-action button fades in, and a cursor flies in to press it, the button scaling down briefly on the click before the frame holds.
build: Icon and wordmark fade/scale in together, tagline reveals with a short opacity+y tween. The button is a DOM pill, fading in then pressed by a cursor on a power3.inOut path with a 0.045s press scale (0.92) and a 0.14s release.
sound: A soft swell as the wordmark lands, a click on the cursor's press, bed fading out over the hold.
prompt: Close on the brand's mark and name settling centred with a short tagline fading up beneath, then a solid call-to-action button fading in and a cursor flying in to press it, with a brief scale-down on the click before the card holds.
